name: MCPHub
description: Manage and orchestrate multiple MCP servers from a panel on the Cate canvas, backed by MCPHub (samanhappy/mcphub). Connects to a locally available MCPHub install; the panel embeds its dashboard, reverse-proxied and loopback-bound.
